text:
tia: FYI invoice preview shows small but consistent positive delta (~0.3%) after the routing TTL change last night.

omar: saw alerts too. quick bisect points to fallback path emitting synthetic billing_events when route tag missing during brief resolver GC.

rui: example pair: be_zz01 (route_tag=null) then be_zz02 (route_tag=fallback), same session_id. aggregator currently dedupes by event_id only.

tia: options: (A) make enricher emit tombstone on retry so downstream can collapse, (B) change aggregator to dedupe by (session_id, seq) with sliding window.

omar: tombstone seems lowest-risk to ship fast. need event_type enum and idempotent semantics.

billing-bot: ALERT: billing-preview-delta 2025-12-04T11:03Z -> 0.31%

rui: UX short-term: add "provisional" badge in preview UI for events with fallback tag or age <1h. reduces support noise.

tia: rollout plan: feature-flag tombstone write, UI badge shipped immediately, canary 5% -> 20%. guard: preview-delta <0.1% and tombstone_applied_rate > 90%.

omar: I'll run replay to measure mem/cost. expect small write volume increase.

oncall-bot: scheduled: enricher-v2 canary deploy 2025-12-04T15:00Z -> notify #eng-oncall

tia: add runbook: flip FF off, how to backfill duplicates, and contact billing-ops. PRs incoming.

rui: replay done: tombstone collapsed ~88% duplicates in our sample, write volume +0.3%, mem delta negligible. good to canary.

tia: thanks all :thumbsup:
